entities.name: Morska
entities.description: A vedalken fish detective from Ravnica, adapted by Simic technology to function underwater, formerly a Simic biomancer.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The biomancer guild Morska left after the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Phyrexian invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which Morska saw biomancers succumb to compleation.

events.summary: Morska saw Simic biomancers experiment with glistening oil and succumb to compleation during the Phyrexian invasion, abandoned the Simic and joined the Agency.
events.quote: she abandoned the Simic and joined the newly flourishing Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations

relations.note: She is its pre-eminent deepwater detective.
relations.quote: the pre-eminent deepwater detective of the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
